newsitem.title: CHINA: Special flight arrives in S.China city.
newsitem.headline: Special flight arrives in S.China city.

text.p: A special flight believed to be carrying North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop on the first leg of his journey out of China arrived on Tuesday morning in the southeastern port city of Xiamen, airport officials said.
Officials declined to say what time the aircraft touched down, but it was reported to have taken off about 7 a.m. from a military airport near Beijing on the 2-1/2 hour flight to Xiamen.
The Xiamen airport official declined to confirm the identity of the passenger aboard the special flight but said he was expected to take a connecting, scheduled flight to Manila.
The route matched that expected to be taken by the North Korean defector who took shelter in the South Korean consulate in Beijing nearly five weeks ago.
The first of two flights on Tuesday from Xiamen to Manila is a Southern Airlines flight that leaves at about 10.10 a.m. (0210 GMT).
Chinese and South Korean officials declined to comment on whether North Korean defector Hwang had already been spirited out of the South Korean mission in Beijing.
